account.note: THE OVERNIGHT HOLD IS THIS SLOT'S ONE JOB AND IT IS DECIDED RATHER THAN DEFAULTED. OKLO is held. 2 shares at a 45.1499 average against a 44.82 bid: -0.73%, 0.66 of unrealized loss on a 90.30 cost, a 54.18 target that needs the bid up 20.9%, a 41.54 stop that needs it down 7.3%, and the 8/14 close as the time stop with today session one of five. Four levels checked against a live bid, four clear, nothing sold, no exit specification owed. THE LEVEL THAT WOULD CHANGE THE HOLD IS 41.54, and the 8/10 rule says this slot writes it down every day rather than deciding a hold once and inheriting it. NO OPTION IS HELD, SO NO NO-FLY WINDOW CLOSES ANYTHING TODAY. The option position list was queried and is empty; that is stated rather than assumed, because the no-fly rule closes a contract TODAY when a print lands before its expiry and it is the one check on this list that is not a judgement call. NO EARNINGS TONIGHT ON THE UNDERLYING EITHER: the calendar was re-pulled live, 934 events across 8/10 to 8/14, OKLO in none of them. No straddle was owed on the position and none is claimed - the rule is that no straddle pulled means no earnings hold, and the way to satisfy it honestly is to have no earnings rather than to describe a number that was never quoted. THE HOLD IS NOT FREE, AND THE ARITHMETIC BELONGS ON THIS SIDE OF THE NIGHT RATHER THAN TOMORROW'S OPEN. OKLO fell 3.60 today - 48.42 to 44.82, -7.44%, the worst name on this board for an eighth consecutive read. From 44.82 another -7.44% lands at 41.49, which is BELOW the 41.54 stop. A repeat of today gaps through the stop rather than filling at it, and the 7.3% of room the stop shows is less protection than the number looks like on a name that has just travelled 7.4% in one session. It is held anyway, and the reason is the rulebook rather than nerve: a position closes when the target, the stop or the time stop says so, not when a run forecasts the next session, and a stop widened or pre-empted by a guess is not a stop. What this run owes is that the risk is named in advance instead of discovered. NOTHING WAS OPENED AND THAT IS NOT A JUDGEMENT CALL. The daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot and discharged at 09:41; this slot is forbidden to open a position in the last thirty minutes, and at 15:35 there are twenty-five minutes left. The board is re-struck on 15:35 bids: four names higher than at 15:21, seven lower, SOUN unchanged to the cent for a FOURTH consecutive read at 7.44. Breadth on the day is unchanged at 10 red of 12. JOBY has taken over as the best name on the list at +1.85% against SMCI at +1.83%, and at 8.80 bid it is five cents under the dead 8.85 limit - the seventh re-mark of the expired forced entry, -0.56%, still underwater after being green at 10:22, red by 3.39% at 14:22, and climbing back most of the way since. Seven marks, four directions, one dead specification: the sequence never carried information and the last one does not either. THE SMCI ROW WAS RE-STRUCK RATHER THAN REFRESHED BY HALVES. spot moved to the live 31.70 bid from 32.52, and the straddle was re-pulled at the same moment so the ratio is struck at one timestamp - 4.355 against 31.70 is 13.7%, from 14.2% this morning. The call and put swapped which is larger, which is spot crossing the 32 strike rather than the market taking a side, and 0.511 against -0.489 in the deltas says so. The refusal is unchanged: an 8% stop sits inside a 13.7% move exactly as it sat inside a 14.2% one. Deployable is 919.58 settled with nothing pending. THE POSITION IS 8.88% OF A 1009.26 ACCOUNT, still under the ~10% floor the 8/10 rule warns at rather than near the 40% ceiling, and that is recorded as a fact about the book rather than an argument to add to it overnight. NO NEW ORDER IN THE ACCOUNT SINCE THE 10:39 FILL, queried directly for a seventh time: one order exists since 8/7, the OKLO buy filled 10:39:30 ET at 45.1499 on a 45.40 limit, placed_agent agentic, with no specification from any run here behind it, and nothing new in the four hours and fifty-six minutes since. The escalation goes to the retro unchanged and uncompounded.
account.priorNote: FOUR LEVELS CHECKED, FOUR CLEAR, AND THE ONE CLAIM LAST HOUR MADE FOR ITSELF IS THE ONE THAT BROKE. OKLO is 44.84 bid against a 45.1499 average, so the position is -0.69%, 0.62 of unrealized loss on a 90.30 cost, against a 54.18 target that needs the bid up 20.8% and a 41.54 stop that needs it down 7.4%. The time stop is the 8/14 close, today session one of five. No option is held, so no no-fly window can apply, and the calendar was re-pulled live rather than carried forward - 934 earnings events across 8/10 to 8/14, OKLO in none of them, SMCI on 8/11 pm verified at an 0.88 estimate still the only watched name inside the window. Nothing was hit, so nothing is proposed. THE 14:22 RUN WROTE THAT ITS FINDING WAS THE FIRST THING TODAY THE NEXT HOUR COULD NOT INVERT. THIS IS THE NEXT HOUR. That run recorded eleven of twelve names bid lower, called it the broadest decline of the session, and banked it as measurement rather than narrative on the grounds that a one-directional board has nothing left to reverse. EIGHT of the twelve are now bid HIGHER than at 14:22, three are lower - by 0.02, 0.02 and 0.20 - and SOUN is unchanged to the cent. Breadth on the day improves to 10 red of 12 from 11, with JOBY joining SMCI in the green. THE CORRECTION IS NARROWER THAN IT LOOKS, AND THE NARROWING IS THE POINT. Two claims were made an hour ago and only one of them failed. The first, that this board moves as one thing, SURVIVES and is arguably better evidenced now than it was then: twelve names went down together at 14:22 and eleven of twelve went up or flat together at 15:21, which is the same correlation observed twice with the sign flipped. The second, that a uniform reading is therefore durable, is FALSE, and it failed inside sixty minutes. Co-movement is the property that persists; direction is the property that does not, and the 14:22 run treated the second as though it inherited the reliability of the first. That is the fourth hour-scale read to invert today and the first to have claimed immunity in writing before doing so. THE TWO-PER-COMPLEX CAP IS UNAFFECTED, because it rests on the half that held. A rule that says four names off this list share one stop needs correlation and does not need to know which way the list is going. THE JOBY SEQUENCE REVERSED TOO, AFTER FIVE MONOTONE READS. The expired forced 8.85 specification has been re-marked six times - a gain at 10:22, then -0.79%, -2.03%, -2.49%, -3.39%, and -1.47% at the 8.72 bid now. Last hour recorded that it had not reversed once in four hours, which was true and is no longer, and the streak was never a rule in either direction. JOBY is +0.93% on the day and the second green name; it is still thirteen cents below the dead limit, so the entry that expired at 10:30 would still be showing a loss. WHAT IS NEW AND STRUCTURAL: THIS IS THE LAST HOURLY OF THE SESSION, AND THAT CLOSES THE ENTRY DOOR BY ARITHMETIC RATHER THAN BY PREFERENCE. The hourly slot runs at :17 from 10:00 to 15:00 ET, so 15:17 is the final one and the 15:33 pre-close is next. A specification published now carries the mandated 30-to-60-minute expiry, which lands between 15:51 and 16:21 against a 16:00 bell: the short end leaves nine tradeable minutes and the long end expires after the market is shut. Either way the fill would have to happen inside the last thirty-nine minutes - precisely the window the rulebook forbids the pre-close from opening a position in. The last hourly publishing an entry does by an earlier slot exactly what the later slot is barred from doing, with less runway, and that is a reason of a different kind from the ones this slot usually gives. Deployable is 919.58 settled with nothing pending. NO NEW ORDER IN THE ACCOUNT SINCE THE 10:39 FILL, queried directly rather than inferred: one order exists in this account since 8/7, the OKLO buy filled 10:39:30 ET at 45.1499 on a 45.40 limit, placed_agent agentic, with no specification from any run here behind it, and nothing new in the four hours and forty-two minutes since. The escalation is carried a sixth hour unchanged and uncompounded. HANDED TO THE PRE-CLOSE, NAMED RATHER THAN LEFT IMPLICIT: the overnight hold on OKLO is the 15:33 slot's decision and not this one's. At 15:21 every level is clear and the position is 8.89% of a 1009.28 account, still under the ~10% floor the 8/10 rule warns at. The level that would change the hold is 41.54.
account.operatorNote: OPERATOR, 2026-08-10, answering the funding escalation carried in the notes above rather than editing either of them. The 900.00 is a deposit I made; the account is funded to about 1000 and the cash is spendable. This answers the deposit and NOTHING ELSE - it is not an authorisation for the OKLO order the 10:46 sync found, which no run here published and which arrived through the same agentic channel escalated on 8/7; that escalation stands open and unanswered. Three rule changes go with it and all three are written up in docs/RULES.md with their arithmetic, because a licence recorded without its constraints is how this record stops being worth reading. The position ceiling goes from two to four, capped at 40% in any one name and at two names in any one complex - the complex cap is the one that matters on a board whose whole universe moves together. Overnight holds are not a change: they were always allowed, the five-session time stop stands, and it is not extendable by conviction. The objective is still about 10% a day, which is roughly 101 dollars at this size and needs a fully deployed four-name book to average +10% in a session against a +20% take-profit; where the objective and the rulebook conflict, the rulebook wins and the retro records the shortfall. What the deposit does NOT do is reopen options - that refusal has been on spread for three sessions, most recently 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling, and no balance narrows a spread. The 10:22 hourly was right to escalate this rather than size against it.
account.openingNote: THIS IS THE OPENING READ AND THE DAILY ENTRY MANDATE IS DISCHARGED, forced on item 1: buy 12 JOBY at a 8.85 limit, target 10.62, stop 8.14, time stop the 8/14 close, expiring 10:30 ET. Exits were checked before entries and there was nothing to check - a flat book means no target, no stop, no time stop and no option expiry no-fly window was due, and none went unenforced. Two things this run settled that were handed to it by name. FIRST, the straddle Friday's pre-close owed to this slot was pulled: the SMCI 8/14 32 call marks 2.51 against a 2.05 put, a 4.56 straddle on a 32.21 spot, so the market prices a 14.2% move on tomorrow night's print. SMCI is refused on that arithmetic and not on a view - the rulebook stops equity at -8%, and an 8% stop sits entirely inside a 14.2% expected move, so the realistic bad case gaps through the stop rather than filling at it and the exit written before entry would not be the exit taken. That matters beyond the refusal, because SMCI was the ONLY name on this board with a forward catalyst, and once it is gone item 1 cannot be passed anywhere on the list. SECOND, options were priced before any thesis was built, as the 8/5 rule requires, and are refused for a third consecutive session on SPREAD rather than affordability: eight contracts quoted live across JOBY, SOUN and SMR at 3-6 weeks, every one clearing the 0.40 delta floor, several affordable outright, and the tightest of them at 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling. Three different cash balances - 128.90, 126.06 and now 109.88 - have produced the same answer, which is the point at which it stops being about the balance. The tape reversed wholesale over the weekend: breadth is 10 RED of 12 after six consecutive 10-green reads on Friday, and the names that extended hardest into Friday's bell are the ones being unwound hardest now. JOBY is one of two green names and the only green one without a print tomorrow. That is the entry, and it is also exactly what is wrong with it - relative strength on a red tape is a real condition and it is not a catalyst, so item 1 is marked fail and the entry is published forced rather than dressed up as something cleaner.

So the honest description of this hold is not that there is 7.3% of room, it is that there is one ordinary session of room on a name currently having ordinary sessions of exactly that size. The 12:22 run made a version of this observation and the level was not reached; that it was not reached then is not evidence about tonight, and neither reading is a forecast. The rulebook closes a position at a level and not at a guess, so it is held, and the risk is recorded in advance rather than explained afterwards. WORST NAME ON THE BOARD FOR AN EIGHTH CONSECUTIVE READ at -7.44%, with SOUN at -7.23% a fifth of a point behind, and two cents lower than at 15:21 on an hour when four of twelve names rose. It continues to have nothing distinguishing to say about itself in either direction, which is the behaviour the two-per-complex cap was written about. SIZE UNCHANGED AND STILL AT THE FLOOR: 89.64 is 8.88% of the 1009.26 account, under the ~10% threshold at which the 8/10 rule warns rather than blocks. Carried to a full +20% take-profit it adds about 18.06, which is 1.8% of the account against an objective near 10% a day. Explicitly not an argument to add overnight - averaging into the worst performer on its own board is on the rulebook's does-not-fit list by name. Provenance unchanged and unresolved after a seventh direct query: one order in this account since 8/7, tagged to the agentic channel, no specification from any run here behind it. That is the retro's to answer; this slot enforces the levels on a position that exists, whoever opened it. Tagged nuclear, which puts SMR and LEU on the same two-name limit as this position.

entryWatch.why: SIX RE-MARKS, AND THE FIFTH-TO-SIXTH IS THE FIRST REVERSAL. At 10:22 this board recorded that the forced 8.85 entry would be showing a gain, JOBY being 9.05 bid. Then -0.79% at 11:22, -2.03% at 12:22, -2.49% at 13:22, -3.39% at 14:22, and -1.47% at the 8.72 bid now. The 14:22 run wrote that the sequence had not reversed once in four hours; it has now, and the streak was not evidence of anything in either direction. What the whole run of six actually demonstrates is the ground the 10:22 refusal rested on: a name that runs 2.3% past its level in forty minutes can come back through it, keep going for four hours, and then take a third of it back inside one - so chasing it upward would have been the error rather than the missed opportunity it looked like at the time. JOBY is +0.93% on the day and the second green name on a board of twelve, and the expired specification would still be underwater at this bid.

entryWatch.why: Unchanged in arithmetic and flat in tape - 31.71 bid, +1.86%, against +1.93% an hour ago, so the four-hour give-back has stalled rather than continued. None of that touches the refusal, which was never about direction. The 8/14 32 call marked 2.51 against a 2.05 put for a 4.56 straddle on a 32.21 spot: a 14.2% implied move against a rulebook stop of 8%. An 8% stop sitting entirely inside a 14.2% expected move is an exit the event is priced to jump rather than fill, which is the sense in which item 3 is a gate and not a formality. Any 3-6 week option necessarily spans the print and is forbidden outright, so the option route was never reachable either. The print is now about twenty-five hours out and this board holds nothing in it. It was the only green name on this list for five consecutive hours and JOBY has now joined it, which removes the one thing that made its pre-earnings bid look like a signal rather than positioning.

entryWatch.trigger: No level, and the tell from last hour has inverted. entryWatch.why: THE CORRELATION HELD AND THE DIRECTION DID NOT, AND ONLY ONE OF THOSE WAS CLAIMED. The 14:22 run recorded twelve names moving one way inside sixty minutes and argued that a uniform board has no internal structure left to reverse, calling it the first finding of the day the next hour could not invert. The next hour inverted it: eleven of twelve up or flat, together, sixty minutes later. What survives is the half the two-per-complex cap actually needs - this list moves as one thing, now demonstrated twice with the sign flipped, which is exactly the claim that four names off it is one position at four times the size with a stop they all gap through together. What fails is the inference that a correlated reading is a durable one. Co-movement persists; direction does not. Four hour-scale character-reads have now inverted today - the 10:22 SOUN and UPST evidence, the 11:22 resumed-falling call, the 12:22 divergence, and now the 14:22 uniformity - and the fourth is the one that wrote down its own immunity first. The hit rate on hour-scale narrative on this board is at chance, and that is now a four-observation finding rather than a three-observation one. NOTHING IS BUYABLE AND NOTHING IS PROPOSED, and on this run the reason is structural as well as discretionary. The mid-session bar is higher than the open's by design and the entry mandate discharged at 09:41. One green hour at the end of a five-hour decline is not the day-2/3 pullback the rulebook buys, and by this hour's own finding it is not evidence of a turn either. Beyond that, 15:17 is the LAST hourly slot of the session: a specification published now expires between 15:51 and 16:21 against a 16:00 bell, so it would have to fill inside the final thirty-nine minutes - the window the rulebook explicitly forbids the 15:33 pre-close from opening a position in. The two nuclear names outside the position are LEU at -0.92% and SMR at -5.50%, and the complex cap would allow exactly one of them.
